title: God Armour+
description: This plugin adds God Armour to the game!
body:
This plugin adds God Armour to the game!
Commands - /godarmour give all
That gives the god armour to the player who executed the command (OP only command)
In the config.yml, you can change the protection level on each armour piece.
You can also edit the dash cooldown for the boots, which you can activate by SHIFT+LEFTCLICK in the direction you want to dash!
You can also edit the effects each armour piece gives, and also the level of that effect. You can also add more effects to each armour piece with this format
- effect: fire_resistance
  level: 1
Restart for all config.yml changes to take effect!

When you wear the whole armour set, it makes everyone in a 50-100 block radius glow
